name: Kenneth "Ken" Petersen
office: Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Kenneth "Ken" Petersen was appointed to the Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency Board of Directors, Division 3, in 2022. A consulting civil engineer and former Valencia Water Company general manager, he chairs the board's Finance and Administration Committee. In April 2025, he voted to approve a rate hike. His campaign says he moved to fund treatment at the T, U, and Saugus wells and backed the S Wells facility.
